description: This file defines styles for tooltips in the project, including CSS variables, positioning, arrow styles, and responsive adjustments. It is part of the Bootstrap tooltip component styles, with custom properties and mixins.

classes.name: tooltip
classes.description: Base class for tooltip styling, including variables, layout, and arrow styling.

classes.name: tooltip-inner
classes.description: Wrapper for tooltip content, controlling max width, padding, color, background, and border radius.

methods.name: reset-text
methods.description: Mixin to reset font and text properties within the tooltip.
